description:
Finds days matching one or more compound weather conditions (e.g. hot + humid, rainy + windy) for a location. Returns up to 5000 most-recent matching events plus the total count.
When to use: Count occurrences of compound weather events across years, study extreme or unusual day combinations, or identify streaks of such events.
Date format: year_start/year_end as YYYY; month_day_start/month_day_end as MMDD for seasonal filtering within each year.
Performance: Computed on demand; returns up to 5000 most-recent matches.
Prerequisites: Use /location to obtain a locid first.
Investigate: Use when the query involves compound conditions — 'how many days had both extreme heat and thunderstorms?' Combine numeric and condition metrics with AND/OR logic.
Augment: Provides event frequency counts for framing rarity in a story ('only 3 such days in the past 20 years').
Notes: Numeric metrics, with unit and valid absolute range: dewp (-30 to 35 °C), gust (0 to 300 km/hr), max_t (-90 to 55 °C), max_wind (0 to 250 km/hr), min_t (-90 to 40 °C), rain (0 to 600 mm), snow (0 to 100 mm), temp (-90 to 50 °C), wind (0 to 200 km/hr). Condition metrics: is_fog, is_hail, is_rain, is_snow, is_thunderstorm. No other metrics are supported. Do not specify lower or upper bound when dealing with absolutes unless it is required. Unspecified bounds default to the metric's full range, and absolute bounds outside that range make the request invalid. Returns: locid, name, error, total_events, events, datestamp, max_t, max_t_complete, min_t, min_t_complete, rain, rain_complete, snow, temp, dewp, wind, max_wind, gust, conditions, criteria_met.

baseline.description: Baseline period used to resolve sigma/percentile bounds, format YYYY_YYYY (default: 1991_2020)

criteria.description: JSON array of criteria objects. Each criterion is either a numeric criterion {"metric":"NAME","bound_type":"A|S|P","lower_bound":VALUE,"upper_bound":VALUE,"must_have":true|false} where bound_type A=absolute (default bounds per metric), S=sigma (-4 to 4), P=percentile (0-100); or a condition criterion {"metric":"CONDITION","state":"1|0","must_have":true|false} with CONDITION one of the is_* metrics. NAME and CONDITION are listed in the description. Defaults: numeric metrics use their natural absolute range; S defaults to [-4,4]; P defaults to [0,100]. At least one must_have=true criterion required.

month_day_end.description: Month-day end filter MMDD e.g. 0831 (Aug 31). Omit for full year.

month_day_start.description: Month-day start filter MMDD e.g. 0601 (June 1). Omit for full year.
